name: OpenConnector | Self-Hosted Composio Alternative for AI Agents
description: Connect 1,000+ apps to your AI agents over MCP, SDK or HTTP. Self-hosted.
card_desc: OpenConnector by OOMOL: a self-hosted connector gateway, the open alternative to Composio and Pipedream. Connect app accounts once and give your agents 10,000+ ready-made actions over MCP, SDK or HTTP, with tokens, scopes and allow/block policies.
